stress_tests.description: Observed 58-epoch live paper run including maker rebates
Maker rebates cut to $0 (pure spread & settlement trading P&L)
Remove top epoch (#43, +$9.87) to test outlier dependency
50 bps adverse execution friction on $751.49 deployed notional
Conservative mainnet: zero rebates + 50 bps fill slippage
100 bps adverse execution friction on deployed notional
Inject a second worst-epoch event ($-6.53) into the 5h window
Unhedged expiry losses amplified by 1.5x (adverse selection spike)
200 bps severe queue/latency degradation across all fills
0% rebates + 100 bps slippage + 1.25x unhedged settlement loss
Unhedged expiry losses double (2.0x) — regime breakdown test
